item.title: From 600 to 5,000 packages an hour: FedEx unveils $150 million Delhi cargo hub
item.summary: FedEx will invest $150 million to build a new air cargo hub in Delhi. This facility will significantly increase package processing capacity at the airport. The hub aims to strengthen air cargo connectivity across North and East India. The Indian government is also focusing on developing cargo hubs and logistics networks. Construction work for the new FedEx facility is expected to begin shortly.
